profile_text.body:
Aurora Innovation, Inc. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA, trading under the ticker AUR with CIK 0001828108. It is also recorded as AURORA INNOVATION INC. Its website, aurora.tech, describes the company as focused on self-driving freight, powered by a system called the Aurora Driver. The site says the Aurora Driver is built with hardware and software backed by what it calls verifiable AI, and that it integrates autonomy into fleets. It presents statements from partners referencing Werner professional drivers, the Volvo VNL Autonomous, and autonomous hauling between Fort Worth and El Paso. One statement says freight volumes are projected to grow five fold between 2010 and 2050.

The site describes the company's approach as transparent and safety-focused, and includes claims that autonomous trucks can improve safety and efficiency and give drivers better lives by handling longer routes. It also says the Aurora Driver is designed to perform like the best CDLs and has driven millions of autonomous miles.

No litigation cases are recorded. Pennsylvania is listed with 168 law exposure entries.
